proposals.name: Left floor crossing
proposals.priority: Manual topology decision before any repair
proposals.finding: The source-fed strip merges with a returning floor loop in a pale, branching-looking junction. An under/over edge is not consistently readable at 4x. The problem is specific occlusion ambiguity, not overall softness.
proposals.protectedConstraints: Do not touch the cream feed unit, microphone, gate, counter geometry, paper print marks away from the junction, or general floor shading.
proposals.decisionNeeded: Which continuation runs over the other? First trace the whole strip(s) and choose a consistent depth order. This may be one folded continuous receipt; do not invent an extra paper source.
proposals.smallestRepair: If needed after tracing, hand-place a short contact-shadow/edge cluster only at the crossing. Keep the existing paper width, curvature and lighting.

proposals.name: Right floor fold or overlap
proposals.priority: Uncertain; may be an intentional continuous fold
proposals.finding: The front descending strip, small right loop and floor shadow merge near the counter base. It is unclear whether this is a crossing of sections or the folded return of the same strip.
proposals.protectedConstraints: Keep counter base, exterior door, floor contact/shadow outside the local junction and all existing paper markings.
proposals.decisionNeeded: Resolve P1 and trace continuity before deciding whether P2 is a defect at all. Do not automatically separate connected paper into new ribbons.
proposals.smallestRepair: Only if Nate finds it confusing, manually distinguish one fold edge or contact shadow. Otherwise keep.

proposals.name: Attendant mouth expression
proposals.finding: The attendant is visibly smiling. The narrative has him shout an emergency instruction. This is a genuine narrative-expression mismatch rather than pixel noise.
proposals.protectedConstraints: Keep hair, spectacles, eyes, nose, face proportions, skin lighting and costume identity. This mask excludes spectacles and upper face.
proposals.decisionNeeded: Decide the precise alarmed expression together with the hand pose; a cosmetic mouth flip alone will not make the whole body read alarmed.
proposals.smallestRepair: After approval, hand-author a small mouth expression using the existing skin/shadow family; do not shrink a portrait or erase useful face detail.

proposals.name: Attendant hands and near forearm
proposals.finding: Clasped hands resting on the counter reinforce a calm seated pose, conflicting with the alarmed beat. Identity, uniform and scale are otherwise continuous.
proposals.protectedConstraints: Keep the existing torso envelope, head, badge, vest/shirt colors, counter edge, feed unit, plant and microphone. Do not introduce new controls or a new red button location.
proposals.decisionNeeded: Choose a restrained stop/urgency gesture within the current proportions. A larger shoulder-grab or standing pose would need separate, wider scope.
proposals.smallestRepair: A coordinated small hand/forearm sprite change after Nate chooses the gesture; preserve the costume shading outside the mask.

scope: Assessment overlays, proposed masks and manual repair handoff only; the approved artwork and all prior reviews remain unchanged.
provenanceLimitation: Original source-derived native-grid authorship remains unresolved. Diagnostic nearest-neighbor enlargements do not change that. No image generation, palette restriction, filtering or artwork resampling occurred.
stopPoint: Nate visual review before any repair or expanded scope.
